chunks: Many of those who call you from outside the apartments are not considerate.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the etiquette of calling the Prophet from behind the private chambers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the sanctity of the Prophet’s domestic sphere (al-hujurat) as a reflection of the spiritual purity of Ahl al-Bayt, where social etiquette mirrors divine reverence. The critique of those who 'lack understanding' (la ya'qilun) highlights not merely intellectual deficiency but a failure in spiritual discernment (fitrah), urging believers to observe proper decorum when approaching the sacred presence. This establishes a precedent for respecting the privacy and status of the Prophet’s family, a core tenet in Shia jurisprudence and spirituality.
